info.title: Fight League: Gear Gadget Generators
info.synopsis: Fight League... la battaglia definitiva a cui tutti i combattenti ambiscono. Al momento, molti marchi si affrontano per ottenere il permesso di partecipare alla Fight League. Uno dei marchi, GGG, ospita la Coppa GGG in cui i combattenti usano i loro costosi arnesi per scalare la vetta. La chiave per vincere è la collaborazione "la sinergia" tra i compagni di squadra. Una ragazza chiamata G-Wrench, che brandisce senza sforzo una enorme chiave inglese, prova a guidare la sua squadra, i Boltechs, mentre cerca di raggiungere il suo sogno. Ma un incontro inaspettato con una misteriosa ragazza, apparsa nel bel mezzo di uno scontro, cambierà il destino di G-Wrench, dei Boltechs e di tutta la GGG.

info.title: Capitan Futuro (ITA)
info.synopsis: La serie narra le avventure di Curtis Newton, detto Capitan Futuro, che viaggia con la sua astronave e difende le popolazioni oppresse con l’aiuto del suo equipaggio. Il protagonista ha perso i genitori quando era un bambino. Suo padre, uno scienziato, aveva abbandonato la Terra per andare a vivere su un satellite artificiale dove si era dedicato alla ricerca scientifica insieme ad un suo amico, il geniale Simon Wright. I due hanno costruito Greg, un robot antropomorfo, e Otto, un androide. Quando il Dottor Wright si è sentito prossimo alla morte ha deciso di impiantare il proprio cervello in contenitore meccanico.

info.title: Viaggio verso Agartha
info.synopsis: Asuna passa i pomeriggi ad ascoltare le misteriose musiche emanate da una antiquata radio a galena, che ha ricevuto dal defunto padre. La protagonista romperà ben presto la routine quotidiana, intraprendendo un viaggio avventuroso per cercare un ragazzino, che l'ha salvata in un occasione di pericolo. Entrerà in un mondo parallelo di cui sperimenterà in prima persona le bellezze, ma anche la crudeltà.

info.title: Words Bubble Up Like Soda Pop
info.synopsis: Questo film ci mostra come le parole e la musica possono connettere un ragazzo e una ragazza: Cherry è un ragazzo terribile nel relazionarsi agli altri, sempre nascosto dalle sue cuffie e sfoga i suoi sentimenti nella sua passione per gli haiku; Smile è una ragazza che si nasconde indietro una maschera per nascondere i suoi largi incisivi per i quali indossa un apparecchio, ma in realtà è famosa su internet e in un suo video parla di come lei sia alla ricerca di "dolcezza". I due ragazzi si incontreranno in un centro commerciale di una città di provincia.

info.title: Maebashi Witches
info.synopsis: A Maebashi nella prefettura di Gunma vive Yuina Akagi, una ragazza che frequenta la prima superiore vivendo una vita quotidiana tanto ordinaria quanto insoddisfacente. Un giorno, una misteriosa rana che si presenta come Keroppe, seleziona lei ed altre quattro ragazze per diventare le "streghe di Maebashi". All'improvviso, l'armadio nella stanza diventa un portale che consente di arrivare in un magico negozio floreale. Qui le ragazze passeranno il tempo a cantare, ballare e realizzare i desideri delle persone.

episodes.title: What`s Wrong with the Status Quo?!
episodes.synopsis: Yuina meets a talking frog and becomes a witch apprentice. Now she must make flowers bloom in people's hearts.

episodes.title: Is That 70% of 100%?

episodes.title: Kyoka-chan, You Sure Are Dumb
episodes.synopsis: Choco is absent from the shop and Yuina comes down with a fever as the Tanabata festival looms ever closer.

episodes.title: The Maebashi Witches Are Far Evermore
episodes.synopsis: Yuina wants to enjoy some classic summer staples before vacation ends, but she's met with reluctance from Azu.

episodes.title: I`ll Never Forget Today, Even After I Forget
episodes.synopsis: The Maebashi Witches must take back the flower shop or lose all memories of their time as witch apprentices.

episodes.title: Have We Met Before?

episodes.title: I Think I`m Done Being a Witch
episodes.synopsis: Yuina and the others have recovered the memories of their time together, but their decision shocks Eiko.

info.title: Astro Boy (1980)
info.synopsis: Remake della serie del 1963. A.D. 2030: nella megalopoli di Tokyo, Astroboy, creato dal Ministro della Scienza dottor Tenma, combatte in nome della giustizia contro Atlas, un super androide munito del "Fattore Omega", un circuito che riflette in lui il lato oscuro dell'animo umano. Atlas, che ha portato il suo creatore, il barone Walpul Giss, alla rovina, sviluppa le sue capacità diventando un potente robot, costruendo poi una base chiamata "Crystal" e sfidando Astroboy a duello.

episodes.title: La nascita di Astroboy
episodes.synopsis: The "Birth of Astro Boy" is the start of electrifying entertainment for many future episodes. Before young Toby dies after a car accident he tells his father to build a robot just like him and to love him. Astro Boy is born and struggles to get used to his powers. He can fly and has strengths which get him in trouble with his father and those around him.

episodes.title: The Robot Circus
episodes.synopsis: After Astro Boy thinks he's disowned by his father he puts his trust into an owner of a circus who wants to exploit Astro Boy's robotic abilities.

episodes.title: Saving Our Classmate

Are they rebelling for being kept in cages?

info.title: Detonator Orgun
info.synopsis: Fuggendo dalla sua stessa razza, Orgun – un essere alieno dotato di abilità sovrumane e armi ultraterrene – viaggia verso la Terra alla ricerca di una risposta sulle sue origini. Lì stringe un legame con un giovane di nome Tomoru per difendere il pianeta dagli Evoluder, che desiderano solo la distruzione delle altre civiltà.

episodes.title: Birth
episodes.synopsis: The EDF create robotic suits based on Orgun in order to defend Earth. Orgun and Tomoru meet two of the Evoluder: Leave, who dies protecting Orgun, and Rang, who battles Orgun in anger for his treason. It is revealed that the Evoluder are the descendants of a manned space mission Earth sent to the Cygnus constellation 200 years earlier, whose crew evolved into mechanical lifeforms due to experiencing millions of years of time dilation during the journey. Some of the Evoluder are telepathically linked to certain humans, such as Tomoru with Orgun and Kumi with the Evoluder's leader, Mhiku.

episodes.title: Showdown
episodes.synopsis: Using their robotic suits, the EDF repels the Evoluder's invasion force. Kumi uses her telekinetic powers to move the Sun so Orgun can save the Earth. Zoa, the Evoluder's military commander, fires the antimatter cannon. Orgun uses his Grand Cross attack to kill Zoa and destroy the cannon. Orgun crashes onto a beach and dies while Tomoru survives. Mhiku resumes ruling the Evoluder, who peacefully leave Earth. Tomoru and Kanzaki walk off into the sunset while Orgun's remains are displayed in a museum.

episodes.title: Puberty Continues
episodes.synopsis: Sakuta has started attending university and meets a girl during a group outing.

episodes.synopsis: Uzuki begins blending into her friend group’s dynamic as her popularity grows.

episodes.title: Idol Song
episodes.synopsis: It’s the day of Sweet Bullet’s performance in an ensemble concert at a venue in Odaiba.

episodes.title: Heroism
episodes.synopsis: A Miniskirt Santa suddenly appears before Sakuta. She says her name is “Touko Kirishima” and claims to have been handing out Puberty Syndrome to people as gifts. Sakuta sees her eyes lock on Ikumi Akagi, a former middle school classmate who is attending the same university as Sakuta, studying in the nursing program. Curious about Ikumi, Sakuta goes on a group date with female nursing program students that his friend invited him to. There, they discuss a rumor about people’s dreams coming true after they post about them on social media with the hashtag #DREAMING...

episodes.title: Dissonant Notes
episodes.synopsis: A pumpkin lantern made of glass comes crashing down in a plaza in front of Sakuragicho Station, just as a social media post with the hashtag #DREAMING had predicted. However, Ikumi rushes in to protect a girl who was running directly underneath it as it falls, preventing any injuries. She believes the rumor about the #DREAMING posts and has been going around saving people. Ikumi visits Sakuta at the university and passes him an invitation to their middle school reunion. Sakuta warns her about helping people too much, but she ignores this advice...

episodes.title: You and I Within the Realm of Memories
episodes.synopsis: A poltergeist-like phenomenon attacks Ikumi. Sakuta is worried the attack was caused by Puberty Syndrome, but Ikumi claims that the only way to fix this problem is by forgetting about Sakuta’s existence. Hearing this, Sakuta is stunned and confused. Without giving him the time to compose his thoughts, Ikumi proposes that they have a contest, competing to see if Sakuta will remember “that day” first, or if Ikumi will forget about Sakuta first.

episodes.title: From Beyond Hilbert Space
episodes.synopsis: Upon searching the hashtag #DREAMING, numerous posts were found about attending a middle school reunion on November 27th. Ikumi also dreamt about the day of the reunion, but in her dream, she injured someone and was arrested.  Sakuta invites Ikumi to visit Minegahara High School, and there, he shares with her the various bizarre things about her that have been bothering him. On the way home, Ikumi suddenly says goodbye to Sakuta as they stand facing each other with the railway tracks in between them…

episodes.title: Secrets and Promises
episodes.synopsis: Sakuta from the other possible realm sends a message through Ikumi that reads, “Find Touko Kirishima, Mai-san is in danger.” After seeing this message, he tries contacting the Miniskirt Santa, who claimed to be Touko Kirishima. A few days later, he receives a call from her saying that she can meet on December 2nd… which also happens to be Mai’s birthday.

episodes.title: I Need You
episodes.synopsis:
Sakuta dreams that on Christmas Eve, when he is meant to have a sleepover date with Mai, he instead goes on a date with a student named Sara Himeji from the cram school where he works. The Sara in question has the same dream as Sakuta and goes on to confess that she has her own Puberty Syndrome. However, she says that she does not want her Puberty Syndrome to be fixed. Sara developed Puberty Syndrome after a heartbreak, and the symptoms of her syndrome ease her anxiety by making her popular with guys, which she has been enjoying.

Sakuta warns her that this is a dangerous move. To which she retorts to provoke him, “What should I do so that I can love people. Like you do, Mr. Sakuta?”

episodes.title: Holy Night
episodes.synopsis:
Sakuta sees a familiar Miniskirt Santa on a beauty pageant website that his friend Takumi Fukuyama was looking at. However, he notices that her name isn’t listed as Touko Kirishima, but rather as Nene Iwamizawa.

As he continues his search for Touko Kirishima, he receives an offer of help from Sara, which he accepts. One of the symptoms of her Puberty Syndrome includes knowing what a person she has collided with is thinking, and that’s how she figured out that Sakuta was looking for Touko Kirishima. Sara suggests reading the Miniskirt Santa’s mind at the venue where she’ll perform her new song live on Christmas Eve.

episodes.title: The World Dreams
episodes.synopsis:
Sakuta has a dream that Mai reveals herself as the true identity of Touko Kirishima at a music festival held on April 1st. At the same time, several major social media platforms were being flooded with posts containing the hashtag #DREAMING, leading to platform crashes and access errors.

As the hashtag #DREAMING causes chaos among the public, Tomoe Koga tells Sakuta that she had a dream that Mai got into an accident, rendering her unconscious during an event where she was collaborating with the police for a public safety awareness.

Sakuta remembers the message he received from himself in the other possible world, stating that Mai is in danger. As he is riddled with worry, the Miniskirt Santa appears before him once again.

episodes.title: Reindeer`s Work
episodes.synopsis:
Mai responds to the media, asserting that she is not the real identity of Touko Kirishima on Coming of Age Day. Nevertheless, the impact of the #DREAMING tag on the public discourse was immense, rendering her unable to dispel the rumors completely. By having Mai herself publicly state that she is not Touko Kirishima, Sakuta has fulfilled his promise with the Miniskirt Santa, and the two of them go out on a date.
During the date, as they shop in Motomachi, but there is not a single person who is able to perceive the Miniskirt Santa. In an attempt to find out more about her, Sakuta ends up hearing an unexpected name. The person she dated back in high school was…

episodes.title: No Dreams of Santa Claus
episodes.synopsis: After her boyfriend Takumi Fukuyama was unable to remember who she is, Nene completely forgets her own identity, and believes that she is Touko Kirishima. The only person who can correct this Puberty Syndrome is Takumi, and Sakuta believes doing so will help him protect Mai. He and Ikumi Akagi rush off to Hokkaido, where Takumi’s hometown is. As Takumi welcomes them at the airport, Sakuta shows the trophy that Nene won at a beauty contest...

info.title: Dead Account
info.synopsis: Sōji Enoshiro ha quindici anni ed è uno streamer controverso che pubblica contenuti sotto lo pseudonimo di "Aoringo". Trasmette intenzionalmente contenuti violenti, clickbait e provocatori per ottenere reazioni e guadagnare soldi, ma tutto questo è causato dal suo bisogno di sostenere le spese mediche della sorella minore. Nella vita reale Sōji è un normale studente che ama mangiare il budino che farebbe di tutto per la propria sorellina. Un giorno, mentre è online, finisce per essere attaccato da un fantasma che si era legato alla rete e questo causa nel ragazzo un trauma che lo porta ad un risveglio spirituale. A causa di ciò finisce per essere reclutato dalla Miden Academy, una scuola specializzata nella formazione degli esorcisti che affrontano gli spiriti che vagano nel regno digitale.

Dopo essere stati abbattuti in volo, precipitano su un’isola apocalittica, piena di armi abbandonate e avvolta da una nebbia velenosa che uccide in 24 ore. A governarla è Muom, un sovrano che sogna l’immortalità e il dominio sul mondo. Intrappolato e senza via di fuga, Lupin dovrà affidarsi solo alla sua astuzia per sconfiggere un nemico apparentemente invincibile...

episodes.synopsis: Inspector Zenigata encounters a terrorist attack at the airport of the Lobbye, and is surprised that the murderer's face was Lupin III. He soon loses sight of it, but finds another “Lupin” at the station and restrains Lupin on the train, but he allows him to escape with the help of Daisuke Dimension. On the other hand, Mine Fujiko infiltrated the circus troupe and was favored by Supreme Leader Breyn as a rider of the aerial swing. With the disarmament treaty parade just around the corner, the National Security Council Karaskov identified and tracked Lupin as a terrorist and a spy of the United States of Alka, but Zenigata was suspicious. Standing in front of Lupin, who was cornered by the National Security Commission in the capital, was a sengata who believed in his innocence. But at that moment, a new explosion hits the sengata...

info.title: Though I Am an Inept Villainess
info.synopsis: Nel palazzo di Hina vengono riunite le principesse di cinque famiglie per formare la nuova generazione di imperatrici. Reirin, una ragazza fragile ma dalla grande bellezza, si ritrova nel corpo di un'altra pretendente al trono, la gelosa Keigetsu. Nessuno crede a Reirin, che nel corpo di Keigetsu si ritrova improvvisamente odiata da tutti e chiamata “principessa ratto”. Ma nonostante tutto, questa situazione non farà altro che rendere la giovane ancora più determinata!

episodes.title: Though I Am an Inept Villainess
episodes.synopsis: Several noble clans live within the Maiden Court, a subset of the Kingdom of Ei's inner court. Reirin the Kou clan Maiden is beautiful and brilliant, currying the favor of Crown Prince Gyoumei. On the other hand, Shu clan Maiden Keigetsu is infamous as a villainess, hated by everyone in the court. On the night of the Double Sevens Festival, Keigetsu uses forbidden magic to swap bodies with Reirin. By the time "Reirin" wakes, Keigetsu's execution has already been set. But even in this time of peril, the frail Reirin is actually delighted that she has gained a healthy body...

episodes.title: Will I Be Living Here?
episodes.synopsis: As a result of the commotion in the inner court, Reirin is ordered by Noble Consort Shu to relocate her room, though this is simply banishment in disguise. Because the new abode is basically an abandoned shed, Leelee the personal court lady for Keigetsu unleashes the frustrations that has been building up within her heart. After lashing out in anger at Reirin, Leelee says she will not take care of her and leaves. Reirin is left alone, beaming from joy of finally having gained freedom...

episodes.title: Shoulders Back, Look Forward
episodes.synopsis: It has been four days since the swap. Reirin, who has been banished to a hut in the Shu Palace, devotes herself to farming utilizing Keigetsu's healthy body. Enjoying a freedom where she doesn't trouble anyone, Reirin spends her days feeling fulfilled. Meanwhile, Leelee is provoked by Gayou, a high court lady from the Kin family who suddenly appeared before her, to harass Reirin...

episodes.title: My Miracle Comet
episodes.synopsis: Keigetsu, suffering from a severe fever, controls a flame to seek help from Reirin. Reirin feels heartbroken seeing Keigetsu managing to calm herself down. Reirin suggests the cancellation of the swap, but the request is rejected. For the upcoming Ghost Festival ritual, Reirin presents Leelee with a garment she had sewn just for Leelee. Meanwhile, Leelee feels that something is off from a certain phrase Reirin unintentionally uttered.

episodes.title: Who Is That Girl?
episodes.synopsis: To settle the score with Gayou who enticed Leelee into harassment, Reirin takes Leelee in tow and heads to the Ghost Festival ritual. Not flinching that a seat was not prepared for her, Reirin wearing a handmade garment with beautiful embroidery stands dignified in the hall. In due time, the offerings of dances by the Maidens begin. Seika of the Kin clan who is hosting the ritual dances brilliantly...

episodes.title: I Won`t Let You Die
episodes.synopsis: Reirin finds it suspicious that Seika said there is no one named Gayou in the Kin clan. Just when she was about to ask for details, the Kou clan court lady Tousetsu comes in with a notice that "Reirin's" life is in danger! Reirin wishes to save "Reirin's" life, but Gyoumei refuses the offer, saying he doesn't trust her. However, the empress Kou Kenshuu tells Reirin that nursing will be allowed if she can show her sincerity by drawing the Bow of Warding all night long.

episodes.title: Meaning of Entrusting a Weapon
episodes.synopsis: After drawing the Bow of Warding continuously, Reirin falls unconscious. Reirin awakens to see Tousetsu, who has caught onto the swapping of the Maidens. Around the same time, Keigetsu realizes that a curse was placed on a gift given to her. Meanwhile, at the Maiden Court, a tea party is being held in celebration of "Reirin's" recovery. There, Kenshuu reminisces about her days as a Maiden that she spent together with Shu Gabi, the Noble Consort.

episodes.title: Like a Villainess, Like a Villainess
episodes.synopsis: Keigetsu realizes that the cause of her illness is a curse created by venomcraft, and has an idea who placed such a curse... Visitation gifts from Seika makes Reirin hypothesize that someone is scheming to make it seem as though the harassment was done by the Kin clan. Worried about Keigetsu, Reirin speaks to a flame. Keigetsu appears in the flame as if to answer that call. But then, Keigetsu asks Reirin for help...

episodes.title: I Will Make Sure to Save You
episodes.synopsis: Reirin realizes that Kenshuu's agony is that of a curse, which gives her an understanding of Gabi's true objective. Reirin asks Gyoumei if she can borrow the Bow of Warding once more, but he will not heed her request. Unable to give up, Reirin heads over alone to see Keigetsu and have the swap cancelled. Right as she passes by Gyoumei, a certain image catches his eye...

episodes.title: Split Curses, Too
episodes.synopsis: Gyoumei realizes the swap between Reirin and Keigetsu and heads over to the Kou Palace in pursuit of Reirin. Tousetsu is inquired about the circumstances by Gyoumei but cannot divulge the truth because of her promise with Reirin. Gyoumei gets the hint from Tousetsu's behavior and shows his resolve by voluntarily removing his crown. Meanwhile, Reirin heads back to the Shu Palace with Keigetsu in tow to deal with the curse...

episodes.title: Quite the Villainess
episodes.synopsis: With the plans to murder Kenshuu using a curse out in the open, Gabi is cornered. She tries to slash Reirin, but is pinned down on the spot. With everything settled, Reirin and Keigetsu decide to cancel the swap. As they are enveloped in flames, the two Maidens tell each other how they feel...
